name: Party flash
summary: A night-out picture lit by one hard flash on the camera. The subject glows against a falling-off, dark background, skin shines and colour is bold; the image looks candid, tipsy and slightly rude.

philosophy.core_thesis: The harsh direct flash is the honest light of a real night, and an image that looks unplanned and unflattering reads as truthful and as cool.
design_principles: Put one flash on the camera axis, at 1.5 to 3m from the subject, with the flash at full or one stop under.
Let the background fall off by 2 to 3 stops, so that it drops to black or to a dark ambient colour.
Shoot at 28mm to 35mm (35mm format), f/2.8 to f/4, 1/60s or 1/30s to let some ambient light in (slow sync).
Keep the flash at 5500K against a warm tungsten ambient of 2800 to 3200K, and let the orange and blue split stay.
Frame the moment loosely: tilted, cut-off, with a friend half in and red eyes allowed.
Grade for punch: clip the highlights at 100%, crush the shadows to 0–5% and raise contrast by +30%.
anti_patterns: Bounce flash, softboxes and diffused fill
A clean, even exposure of the room
Perfect skin, retouched shine and corrected red eye
Careful composition with a clear subject on a third
A tripod or a posed group in rows

composition.framing: Tight, tilted, in a 3:2 or 4:5 frame; people crowd the edges.
composition.viewpoint: Handheld at chest or face height, 1.5 to 3m, sometimes from the hip.
composition.geometry: Flat plane of lit faces against a dark void; a hard shadow on the wall behind the subject.
composition.subject_placement: Centred or off centre by chance; faces take 30–60% of the frame.

light.quality: Hard direct flash, small source, strong specular shine on skin and glass.
light.direction: From the camera axis, slightly above the lens; the shadow falls behind the subject.
light.key_to_fill_ratio: 8:1 or more (3 stops or more), flash to ambient
light.colour_temperature: Flash 5500K; ambient 2800–3200K (tungsten) or coloured club light

lens_and_camera.format: 35mm film compact or a digital compact or phone with a flash
lens_and_camera.focus: Autofocus on the nearest face; the depth of field is 1 to 4m and the rest falls into the dark.

colour_and_grade.treatment: High-contrast, warm-skin, with a black background and bold colours of clothes and lights; some blue-orange split from mixed light.
grade_recipe: Set the white point at 100% with 3% of the highlights clipped on skin.
Crush the black point to 3% and let the background fall to #0B0A10.
Add +30% contrast with a hard S-curve.
Raise saturation by +10% and keep the flash at 5500K against warm ambient.
Add film grain, amount 20%, size 30%, or JPEG noise of 8%.
Add a soft red-eye glow only when it is in the original.
colour_and_grade.grain: ISO 400 colour film or sensor noise at ISO 800

subject_and_staging.staging: None; the photographer shoots in the crowd and the subject often grabs the camera.
subject_and_staging.direction: Subjects lean in, laugh, pose in a messy group and look at the lens; nobody is directed.

workflow: Shoot the whole night; take 300 frames and keep 10.
Scan the film or import the JPEG; make no skin retouching.
Apply a single contrast and saturation preset to the set.
Post as an unedited carousel with the original crop.
post_processing.output: A square or 4:5 image on a screen, or a 4×6 in lab print with a white border.

positive: harsh flash shadows on the wall

emotion.target_response: Immediacy and nerve: the viewer feels the heat of a crowded night and the thrill of being in the picture.

avoid_when: The brief needs a flattering or premium product image.
Faces must look soft, calm or formal.

modifiers.how: Add a key light and a fill at 4:1, light the background, and grade to teal and orange; keep the night setting.
Drop the flash, shoot in found light at ISO 1600, f/2 and 1/250s, and convert to grainy black and white.

sources.title: Nan Goldin, The Ballad of Sexual Dependency (Aperture, 1986)
